issues.reason: The antecedent-less-pronoun rule classes the witness "by what the pronoun means" and falls back to thing when the text supplies no kind; the demonstrative "those" names no kind, so (GroupOf sk_those_1 person) asserts personhood no word in the sentence states.
The subset group carries the same unstated personhood — (GroupOf sk_claimants_1 person) is over-asserted for exactly the reason above.

The reviewer's own second gap is the answer — a descriptive adjective on a bare-class generic object has no attachment site (fusion is barred for incidental description, the distributive route needs a group witness the generic-object rule forbids, and (Inheritance disease specific) would be false) — so leaving the unslottable modifier out rather than mis-slotting it is the instruction set's own remedy, not a defect.

gaps_confirmed: an antecedent-less demonstrative plural ("of those") — the pronoun fallback rule covers he/she/they/it but not demonstratives, so nothing fixes the member kind of the presupposed superset
an adjectival modifier on a bare-class generic object ("specific diseases") has no attachment site
direct quotation of the predicate ("claimed to treat ...") — the instruction set has no treatment of quoted material, so the quotation marks are consumed
new_gaps: an appositive restatement of a count as a percentage ("149, or 55%") — this "or" is not disjunction, and neither Disjunction nor Partitives says the cardinal and the proportional atom may sit together on one subset group (the parse's Cardinality + ProportionOf pairing is unlicensed improvisation, though a true one)
repair_summary: Retyped both group witnesses from the unstated person to the licensed fallback thing: (GroupOf sk_those_1 thing) and (GroupOf sk_claimants_1 thing).
notes: Everything else stands — the partitive shape (superset + SubsetOf + Cardinality 149 + un-reduced (Fraction 55 100)) and the control-verb route for "claimed to V" (complement events reified tenseless, controller's Agent copied in, Theme link inside each narrow-scope Or branch) are both licensed.
